newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Reef Casino Trust shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Reef Casino Trust shares suspended.

text.p: Shares in Reef Casino Trust will be suspended from the start of trading on Tuesday at the request of the manager of the trust, the Australian Stock Exchange said on Tuesday.
Late last month, financiers withdrew an external working capital facility used to fund high-rolling gambler visits to the Reef Casino at Cairns in north Queensland.

The operator of the loss-making casino, Casinos Austria International Ltd (CAI), said last week that junket and premium player gaming at the Reef Casino would not be available until further notice as a result.
A report from Grant Samuel & Associates on the trust's refinancing and restructuring options was due to have been provided to a board meeting on Monday.
Reef hired Grant Samuel in October after the trust reported a A$5.9 million loss for the quarter ended September 30.
